children: Overview
Plantation operator's H1 revenue rose 8.3% yr/yr on Pinago acquisition
Profit before tax up 5.1%, aided by $9.1 mln non-recurring gain from Pinago deal
Company returned $25.9 mln to shareholders via dividends and share buybacks
Outlook
Company expects CPO prices to remain firm for the rest of 2026, supported by demand
Company to benefit from full six months trading from Pinago acquisition in H2
Company says it remains confident of achieving market expectations for the full year
Result Drivers
PINAGO ACQUISITION - Revenue and profit growth driven by Pinago acquisition, which added mature plantation area and contributed $18.3 mln in revenue and $3.5 mln in profit before tax
PRODUCTION VOLUMES - Higher own and external FFB production, especially in Kalimantan and from Pinago, supported CPO and PK output
REPLANTING IMPACT - Ongoing replanting programme and delayed cropping cycle in North Sumatra and Riau weighed on underlying profit before tax
